checks.label: 桌面 Chromium：新开局、旧档、临床、科研、退出、晚年和重开档

scenarios.label: 新开局
scenarios.steps: Launch production build, start a new game, allocate attrs, enter first playable scene.
scenarios.passCriteria: No crash; state initializes from defaults; first scene is interactable.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record device/browser, route notes, screenshot if layout is suspect.

scenarios.label: 继续旧档
scenarios.steps: Create or load an existing save, reload browser, continue from title.
scenarios.passCriteria: Save loads without unsafe migration; age/year/stage and key flags remain coherent.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record save origin/version and resumed stage.

scenarios.label: 完整临床线
scenarios.steps: Play a full clinical-oriented lifecycle through job/career into a final ending.
scenarios.passCriteria: Clinical route reaches a route-appropriate ending; no early dropout/quit ending after full practice.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record route choices, final stage, ending id, age/year.

scenarios.label: 完整科研线
scenarios.steps: Play a research-oriented lifecycle through master/PhD/career into a final ending.
scenarios.passCriteria: Research route reaches a route-appropriate ending; papers/reputation effects are visible.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record route choices, final stage, ending id, age/year/papers.

scenarios.label: 退出线提前终止
scenarios.steps: Choose a supported exit path such as leaving undergrad or quitting guipei.
scenarios.passCriteria: Route terminates immediately at the matching exit ending and does not continue later seasons.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record exit choice, ending id, age/year.

scenarios.label: 晚年三阶段
scenarios.steps: Reach pinnacle/retirement/eternity phases and play through late-life decisions.
scenarios.passCriteria: Late-life personal echoes appear; age/year/quarter remain coherent; final ending matches legacy/health state.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record late-life phases visited, ending id, age/year.

scenarios.label: 重开档并确认状态重置
scenarios.steps: From a populated save, start over and then reload once.
scenarios.passCriteria: New run resets prior flags/resources and persists its own fresh state.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record old/new stage and any reset anomalies.

scenarios.label: 生产包控制台无错误
scenarios.steps: Open production build with DevTools console while exercising the target scenarios.
scenarios.passCriteria: No uncaught errors, failed asset loads, or persistent console error spam.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record console status; paste exact errors if any.

checks.label: iOS Safari 真机：竖横屏、安全区、触控、长时操作和音频解锁

scenarios.label: 竖屏布局
scenarios.steps: Open on the target phone in portrait and navigate title, HUD, event cards, endings.
scenarios.passCriteria: No clipped primary controls; text remains readable; scrolling/taps work.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record device model, OS/browser version, screenshots for issues.

scenarios.label: 横屏布局
scenarios.steps: Rotate to landscape and repeat title, HUD, event cards, endings.
scenarios.passCriteria: Layout adapts without hidden controls or unusable hit targets.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record rotation behavior and screenshots for issues.

scenarios.label: 刘海与安全区
scenarios.steps: Check notch/home-indicator/status-bar areas on title, gameplay, modal/card, ending.
scenarios.passCriteria: Interactive UI stays outside unsafe areas or remains comfortably tappable.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record affected screens and screenshots if unsafe.

scenarios.label: 触控小游戏
scenarios.steps: Play touch-driven minigames and dismiss overlays using only touch.
scenarios.passCriteria: Gestures register reliably; no keyboard-only blocker; ESC alternatives exist where needed.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record minigames tried and any missed taps.

scenarios.label: 长时间操作与多次切场景
scenarios.steps: Play continuously with multiple scene transitions, save/load, and orientation changes.
scenarios.passCriteria: No memory/performance degradation, stuck overlay, or lost input after long operation.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record duration, transitions, and final state.

scenarios.label: 首次用户手势解锁音频
scenarios.steps: Start from a fresh browser session, perform first user gesture, trigger sound.
scenarios.passCriteria: Audio starts only after user gesture and does not throw browser autoplay errors.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record gesture used, sound status, console status.

scenarios.label: 生产包控制台无错误
scenarios.steps: Open production build with DevTools console while exercising the target scenarios.
scenarios.passCriteria: No uncaught errors, failed asset loads, or persistent console error spam.
scenarios.evidenceToRecord: Record console status; paste exact errors if any.
